pages.title: Cozy Gnomes
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Inspect illustrated scenes in Cozy Gnomes. Search each small area for its concealed gnome and click or tap when you spot it. Finding the hidden character completes the level and opens another location with new details to examine.

pages.title: Cozy Jigsaw
pages.creator: Hyperchip
pages.description: Reassemble pictures at your own pace in Cozy Jigsaw. Drag the scattered sections and let them snap into their proper positions. Compare shapes and image details as you work toward rebuilding the complete scene from its individual pieces.

pages.title: Racing for two on one PC!
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Share a driving challenge with a friend in Racing for two on one PC!. Complete the track quickly while avoiding obstacles and compare your finishing times. Reset a car that flips or leaves the road, then continue working toward a faster run.

pages.title: Pop The Bubble
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Clear formations of colored balls in Pop The Bubble. Aim shots to make groups of at least three matching bubbles and use boosters to reach difficult targets. Bombs, rockets, and multicolored shots offer different ways to clear the layouts and earn rewards.

pages.title: Garten Of BanBan 1 Escape
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: Investigate a deserted kindergarten in Garten Of BanBan 1 Escape. Explore rooms and interact with objects to uncover what happened inside the establishment. The mascots' surroundings hide a darker story, and dangerous company makes surviving the investigation part of finding the truth.

pages.title: Cool SuperCars Stunts PvP
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Drive a customized performance car through a stunt city in Cool SuperCars Stunts PvP. Explore three modes or compete directly with a friend in the two-player activities. Separate keyboard controls let both drivers handle their cars during the shared contest.

pages.title: Idle PinBall - Merge Clicker
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Develop a merging-based income system in Idle PinBall - Merge Clicker. Combine elements into new forms, earn money, and increase passive production. Unlock further levels, bonuses, and improvements as you work toward a more efficient pinball-themed operation.

pages.title: Winter Maze
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Paint every accessible tile in Winter Maze. Swipe to roll the ball through icy passages and plan a route that reaches each corner. Complete the entire field to open the next puzzle without leaving any section untouched.

pages.title: Inspector Cat
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Compete in timed searches in Inspector Cat. Find requested items on a crowded board while rival feline inspectors look for the same objects. Accurate, quick selections earn points and help your character climb the ranking across the rounds.

pages.title: Hidden Object Farm Adventure
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Search rural scenes in Hidden Object Farm Adventure. Each of thirty levels asks you to locate six objects before the countdown expires. Scan the illustrated details carefully and use a hint when an item remains difficult to find.

pages.title: Stickman Archero Fight: stick shadow fight war
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Fight through different environments in Stickman Archero Fight: stick shadow fight war. Collect equipment, put it on through the inventory, and improve the items supporting your character. Experiment with skill combinations and finish attacks while working through the enemy-filled levels.

pages.title: Geometry Vibes 3D
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Navigate three-dimensional rhythm courses in Geometry Vibes 3D. Time jumps around the route's hazards and keep responding as the level unfolds. Play alone or use the two-player mode, where each participant has a separate control for guiding their character.

pages.title: Uphill Rush 13
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Ride water-park courses in Uphill Rush 13. Choose among tubes, surfboards, and personal watercraft as you handle loops and long jumps. Perform stunts for bonuses and unlock additional power-ups and appearances while progressing through the aquatic tracks.

pages.title: Block Combo Blast
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Fit the offered shapes onto a grid in Block Combo Blast. Complete rows or columns to clear tiles and score, planning around the three available pieces. The game ends when none of those choices can fit into the remaining space.

pages.title: Dynamons Connect
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Connect matching creature tiles in Dynamons Connect. A usable pair needs a clear path with no more than two turns between its pictures. Remove pairs to open further routes and keep working through the remaining Dynamons on the board.

pages.title: Bouncy Barn
pages.creator: Csharks Games & Solutions Pvt Ltd.
pages.description: Develop a producing farm in Bouncy Barn. Feed and care for chickens, cows, and goats so they provide eggs, milk, and other products. Sell the harvest at the market and reinvest the earnings in expanding and improving the farm.

pages.title: Ragdoll Show: Throw, Break and Destroy!
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Guide a physics-driven character through destructive challenges in Ragdoll Show: Throw, Break and Destroy!. Direct the ragdoll around each level and use its movement and collisions to complete the task. Different arrangements test how you turn a loose-limbed body into the required result.

pages.title: Ice Cream Fever Cooking Game
pages.creator: Magic Game Studio
pages.description: Serve frozen desserts in Ice Cream Fever Cooking Game. Prepare ice creams and sundaes with different toppings, then complete customer orders through tapping controls. Upgrade the kitchen's equipment to support the cooking service as you work through the treat-making challenges.

pages.title: Airport Master Plane Tycoon
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Manage passenger flow in Airport Master Plane Tycoon. Control the airport manager and open facilities such as gates, scanners, security checks, and lounges. Meet the passenger target set for each level while developing the terminal's services.

pages.title: Make America Great Again
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Hold back wrestlers in Make America Great Again. Watch opponents charging toward the ring's central character and press the appropriate directions to land punches. Unlock temporary strength boosts that let a single powerful attack knock out several enemies in a row.

pages.title: Tile Farm Story - Matching Game
pages.creator: Rainbow Games
pages.description: Solve collection puzzles to restore nature in Tile Farm Story - Matching Game. Select identical tiles and clear matching groups while preserving room in the collection slots. Help the Stone sisters develop parks and reserves as they investigate their grandfather's mysterious inheritance.

pages.title: Draw Bridge Challenge
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Create a crossing with one continuous stroke in Draw Bridge Challenge. Drag to draw a stable route that carries the car toward the flags. You only get one line, so plan its supports and shape before sending the vehicle across.

pages.title: L.O.L. Surprise Game Zone
pages.creator: Tap Tap Tales
pages.description: Explore a city of activities in L.O.L. Surprise Game Zone. Visit shops and buildings to discover puzzles, shopping, music, language exercises, and decoration tasks. Choose different minigames as you investigate the locations and the surprises available around town.

pages.title: Mermaids Spot The Differences
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Compare ocean scenes in Mermaids Spot The Differences. Examine paired pictures of mermaids and sea creatures, then click the details that change between them. The challenge centers on distinguishing small alterations among the underwater illustrations.

pages.title: Turbo Trucks Race
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Drive heavy vehicles through competitive events in Turbo Trucks Race. Choose among trucks with different abilities, use nitro, and connect trailers where needed. Explore landscapes in FreeMap mode or share the driving activities with a second player using separate controls.

pages.title: Gate Heroes Battle
pages.creator: Liones Games
pages.description: Strengthen a monster during a running course in Gate Heroes Battle. Steer through beneficial gates and keep away from traps that interrupt the growth. Try to arrive at the final boss in a powerful enough form to defeat it.

pages.title: Gorilla Adventure
pages.creator: GM Media
pages.description: Climb an eerie futuristic city in Gorilla Adventure. Use hammer swings to gain height and reposition the character through the platforming challenge. Judge each movement carefully as you try to reach the top and set a stronger climbing record.

pages.title: Ride Shooter
pages.creator: Dorfer Games OU
pages.description: Break through an undead world in Ride Shooter. Equip a car with armor and weapons, then use it to force a route through the zombies. Expand the attacking options with equipment such as machine guns, lasers, and helicopter support.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Party Prep
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Help a host prepare a family gathering in Thanksgiving Party Prep. Dress Emily in a festive outfit and coordinate makeup and hair before joining her in the kitchen. Cook turkey and pumpkin pie as part of getting the holiday dinner ready.

pages.title: Word Search - Fun Puzzle Games
pages.creator: AppyApp
pages.description: Identify pictured creatures in Word Search - Fun Puzzle Games. Each level shows two animals whose names are hidden in a letter field. Drag through the correct letters to highlight both answers and progress through the game's achievement-based learning ranks.

pages.title: Fantasy Madness
pages.creator: NIGHT STEED S.C.
pages.description: Protect the natural world in Fantasy Madness. Move through hostile crowds, dodge attacks, and use nature-granted magic against orcs and other enemies. The survival action revolves around keeping the character alive while applying the available arcane powers to the advancing forces.

pages.title: Apple Shooter
pages.creator: Andrew Wolf
pages.description: Hit every apple to complete a stage in Apple Shooter. Choose from several arrow types, including guided and explosive projectiles, and customize the archer. Balloons add optional points, while coins provide more arrows, giving you reasons to judge shots beyond the required fruit targets.

pages.title: 2048 Ball Buster
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Combine numbered pieces in 2048 Ball Buster. Merge and eliminate digital balls to raise their values and improve your score. Successive levels add further requirements, asking you to meet the current target while building useful combinations among the balls.

pages.title: Wordle Stack 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Assemble a word guess by collecting letters in Wordle Stack 3D. Bring the selected letters together to check the answer. Green marks show correct letters in their proper positions, while yellow marks identify useful letters placed in the wrong spots.

pages.title: Crowd Lumberjack
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Build an island settlement in Crowd Lumberjack. Move a growing team through forests to automatically chop trees and carry wood into construction projects. Recruit more workers, complete buildings, and discover additional islands as the group turns timber into expanding cities.

pages.title: Queen Clara Then and Now
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Give a queen two contrasting looks in Queen Clara Then and Now. Choose traditional clothing for one appearance and modern fashion for the other. Coordinate the available pieces so Clara can compare complete outfits representing both styles.

pages.title: Princess Influencer Salon
pages.creator: FreezeNova.Games
pages.description: Create fantasy looks in Princess Influencer Salon. Help the princesses try fairy dresses while preparing their wishes for a wonderland. Browse the customization choices and coordinate the clothing into finished magical outfits for the characters.

pages.title: Dirt Bike Stunts 3D
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Ride mountain courses in Dirt Bike Stunts 3D. Watch cliffs and sharp turns while working through ten levels, earning cash from completed races. Buy motorcycles and character skins, or improve tires and brakes to make the bike easier to handle.

pages.title: Turd Show
pages.creator: Nevar Games
pages.description: Recreate a deliberately silly reference model in Turd Show. Draw the requested shape and drag decorative objects onto it, following the level's instructions. Compare your finished result with the example and try to produce a closer match than the opponent.

pages.title: Yummy Cupcake
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Bake and sell decorated treats in Yummy Cupcake. Prepare the dough, choose paper cases, and add frosting and toppings to the finished cakes. Bring the cupcakes to customers after completing the kitchen work, linking preparation with running the service.

pages.title: Squid Shooter
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: Fight a crowd of game-show-inspired enemies in Squid Shooter. Choose among a large firearm arsenal and avoid thrown explosives and melee attacks from guards and players. Use heavier weapons against giant dolls while keeping your character alive through the invasion.

pages.title: Funny Battle Simulator
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: Arrange an unusual army in Funny Battle Simulator. Deploy infantry, archers, Spartans, cyclopes, and grenadiers, or bring Zeus's lightning into the battle. Adjust unit placement and inspect the field with the camera as you test which force can defeat the opposing side.

pages.title: Doll Designer
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Collect a requested outfit during a run in Doll Designer. Slide toward the correct clothes and decorations while avoiding unsuitable items. Complete more than three quarters of the required selection to pass the level and finish the doll's planned appearance.

pages.title: Rally Point 3
pages.creator: Xform
pages.description: Beat off-road time limits in Rally Point 3. Use drifting and unlimited nitro to keep a fast line, but watch the car's temperature. Excessive boosting can cause an explosion, so manage the heat while working to unlock further vehicles and tracks.

pages.title: Run! and Escape
pages.creator: Renan Games
pages.description: Reach the exit quickly in Run! and Escape. Move left and right and jump through the obstacles separating the character from safety. Each stage adds another platforming challenge, asking you to keep progressing without letting hazards stop the escape.

pages.title: Pink Cuteman
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Guide a small one-eyed character toward a snowy forest in Pink Cuteman. Cross ten levels, avoiding enemies on the ground and in the air. Reach each flag to finish the stage and move another step along the journey.

pages.title: Incredible Princess Eye Art
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Create elaborate cosmetic designs in Incredible Princess Eye Art. Use makeup tools around the princesses' eyes and experiment with styles ranging from doll-like to cyber-inspired. Try different artistic approaches to produce a distinct look for each makeover.

pages.title: BTS Pony Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Color illustrated equines in BTS Pony Coloring Book. Choose a drawing and add your preferred shades to the outlined areas. Work through the pony's features and surrounding details to turn the picture into an individual finished design.

pages.title: Gravity Balls
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Reverse the pull on a bouncing character in Gravity Balls. Tap to change gravity, avoid obstacles, and guide the ball through the magical exit. Thirty levels offer different arrangements to cross while the game selects from its available ball appearances.

pages.title: Christmas Trucks Hidden Gifts
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Find concealed presents in Christmas Trucks Hidden Gifts. Each truck picture contains ten gifts, with sixty seconds available to identify them all. Search six scenes and retry a level when the timer expires before the collection is complete.

pages.title: Vintage Cars Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Line up matching vehicles in Vintage Cars Match 3. Create groups of at least three same-colored pieces to earn points. Keep the gauge at the side from dropping too low by continuing to find useful matches among the car tiles.

pages.title: Mahjong Connect Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Connect identical tiles in Mahjong Connect Deluxe. A valid route may bend no more than twice, so keep checking which pairs have a clear path. Finish each of eighteen boards before time expires and work toward extra points from faster clears.

pages.title: The Farmers
pages.creator: comeplay
pages.description: Create a personalized agricultural business in The Farmers. Spend coins to reclaim land, plant crops and fruit trees, or raise livestock. Harvest products to earn money for further development, choosing the balance of farming activities you want to expand.

pages.title: Grand City Car Thief
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Steal vehicles across an open city in Grand City Car Thief. Explore on foot, enter the cars you find, and bring them back to your garage. The missions focus on collecting those vehicles while navigating the surrounding streets.

pages.title: Hangman Challenge
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Reveal a word before the drawing is completed in Hangman Challenge. Use the category hint to guide your letter choices and uncover correct entries in the answer. Wrong guesses add parts to the hanging figure, limiting how many mistakes you can make.

pages.title: Jungle Bricks
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Collect fruit by destroying targets in Jungle Bricks. Aim a volley of balls to hit as many bricks as possible and gather their rewards for the jungle boy. Remove every brick from the screen to complete the stage and continue.

pages.title: DEADLY Dinosaur Hunter Shooter
pages.creator: mastergame
pages.description: Take on prehistoric hunting assignments in DEADLY Dinosaur Hunter Shooter. Explore mountain and glacial terrain while looking for the dinosaurs required by the task. Move with the keyboard, focus your aim with the right mouse button, and fire with the left.

pages.title: Count Holiday Cards
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Answer quick counting questions in Count Holiday Cards. Look at the gift cards displayed by the game, determine their number, and choose the matching answer. The challenge centers on recognizing the total accurately while keeping the counting moving.

pages.title: T_rex Run
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Keep a dinosaur running in T_rex Run. Tap at the right moment to jump clear of obstacles along the route. Continue the run without a collision and work toward covering more distance with each attempt.

pages.title: Sky Ski
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Ski around trees and rocks in Sky Ski. Guide the character downhill and collect gold, avoiding collisions that force you to restart. Spend the gathered currency to unlock different skiers as you work on extending the descent.

pages.title: Kara Water Hop
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Help a flightless chicken cross a lake in Kara Water Hop. Use normal or double jumps to land on the platforms floating ahead. The character cannot swim, so judge each gap carefully to keep the journey from ending in the water.

pages.title: Teddy Escape
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Evade a pursuing aircraft in Teddy Escape. The bear and jet move around a circular route, and clicking changes the bear's direction. Watch the chase and reverse at useful moments to keep Teddy away from the plane.

pages.title: Zombie Slasher
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Cut down incoming undead in Zombie Slasher. Slash the zombies appearing in the play area and keep dealing with the advancing targets. The challenge focuses on reacting to the next enemy and removing it with another attack.

pages.title: Emma Play Time
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Explore shopping and household activities in Emma Play Time. Visit supermarket and mall tasks involving groceries, clothing, cleaning, recycling, and slicing food. The collection combines different parts of a shopping trip with related minigames and everyday responsibilities.

pages.title: Happy Valentines Day Spot the Differences
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Compare romantic postcard scenes in Happy Valentines Day Spot the Differences. Inspect the paired images and select the details that do not match. Keep scanning the small decorations and characters until every requested alteration has been found.

pages.title: Humans vs Undead
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Deploy an army against supernatural enemies in Humans vs Undead. Select units and place them on the battlefield, then observe how your formation performs. Complete campaign missions and adjust the army while using the camera to inspect the battle from different angles.

pages.title: Perfect Christmas Cottage
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Help Alice prepare a holiday home in Perfect Christmas Cottage. Decorate the newly purchased candy house using the available design choices. Combine the seasonal elements into a finished cottage ready for the approaching Christmas and New Year celebrations.

pages.title: Crazy Shoot
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Work a football past defenders in Crazy Shoot. Move with the arrow keys or WASD, keep away from opposing players, and kick toward the goal. The challenge connects navigating through the defense with finishing the scoring attempt.

pages.title: Treasure Ninja
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Join colored jewels in Treasure Ninja. Click and drag lines through matching pieces to create combinations and work through the puzzle. Keep inspecting the arrangement for another useful connection as the jewel-matching challenge continues.

pages.title: Halloween Arkanoid Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Clear spooky targets in Halloween Arkanoid Deluxe. Move a paddle with the mouse or touch controls to return the bouncing ball toward the monsters. Destroy every target to complete a level and advance through the twenty-four stages.

pages.title: Street Racing 3D
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Compete on urban roads in Street Racing 3D. Accelerate, brake, reverse, and steer with the keyboard as you work on controlling the car through the race. Change the camera when useful and try to improve your driving performance across the street course.

pages.title: How Smart Are You
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Answer a mixture of general-knowledge questions in How Smart Are You. Test subjects such as geography, history, music, technology, and popular culture as the quiz presents them. Choose your responses and see how consistently you can recognize the correct facts.

pages.title: Snow Fast Hill Track Racing
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Drive performance cars across snowy courses in Snow Fast Hill Track Racing. Steer through the turns and manage drifting on the wintry tracks while competing for the championship. WASD controls the car as you work on keeping a faster line through the course.

pages.title: Flutter Shooter
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Shoot open a route through block barriers in Flutter Shooter. Destroy the pieces ahead so the flying character has space to continue. The game combines controlling the flight with clearing the obstacles that would otherwise close its path.

pages.title: Camping Adventure Games
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Prepare for an outdoor trip in Camping Adventure Games. Work through activities involving packing equipment, assembling a tent, fishing, and a campfire. The collection moves between different tasks that form parts of setting up and enjoying the campsite.

pages.title: Princess Fashion Cosplay
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Prepare two friends for a costume appearance in Princess Fashion Cosplay. Help Mia and Bella exchange styling ideas and choose dresses and accessories for their looks. Coordinate the finished outfits before they show their cosplay choices to the group.

pages.title: Full Goat Biryani Preparation
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Prepare a flavorful dish in Full Goat Biryani Preparation. Start by purchasing the required ingredients, then work through the cooking activity. Follow the sequence from shopping to meal preparation to complete the game's full-goat biryani recipe.

pages.title: Crazy Monster Trucks Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Put together oversized-vehicle pictures in Crazy Monster Trucks Puzzle. Choose an easy, medium, or hard arrangement and rebuild the selected image from its pieces. The untimed format lets you compare shapes and details without a countdown interrupting the puzzle.

pages.title: Paint Pop 3D
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Cover targets with timed shots in Paint Pop 3D. Send paint toward the rotating arrangement while keeping the shots away from obstacles. Complete one section to continue through the levels, choosing openings that allow the paint to reach its intended surface.

pages.title: Break the Hoops 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Break vulnerable sections of rotating rings in Break the Hoops 2. Swipe to turn the hoop and line up its weak points while avoiding obstacles. Work through a hundred levels as the arrangements make the destructive route harder to follow.

pages.title: EG Roll Baller
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Build a continuous route in EG Roll Baller by sliding puzzle tiles into place. Connect the path so the ball can reach its destination, considering how each move shifts the available pieces. Two modes offer a collection of two hundred layouts to solve.

pages.title: Ninja Run HTML 5
pages.creator: YAKPI
pages.description: Guide a runner across uneven terrain in Ninja Run HTML 5. Jump between platforms and stay clear of gaps and water while continuing along the route. Keep the ninja moving safely as you work toward increasing the distance and score.

pages.title: Princess Poppins
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Imagine an updated wardrobe for a familiar nanny in Princess Poppins. Explore whether to keep her traditional hat and umbrella or replace them with modern alternatives. Coordinate the clothing and accessories into your own contemporary version of the character.

pages.title: Halloween Pizzeria
pages.creator: Restaurant Games
pages.description: Serve hungry creatures in Halloween Pizzeria. Prepare pizzas for the little monsters visiting the restaurant and complete their food requests. The seasonal cooking game centers on making the dishes needed to keep the monster customers fed.

pages.title: Princess Sneakers Design
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Create customized footwear in Princess Sneakers Design. Choose colors, patterns, and decorative details for shoes being entered into a fashion event. Complete an individual sneaker design and see how the judging panel responds to the finished style.

pages.title: Mango Mania
pages.creator: Urbanduckgames
pages.description: Help a small jungle creature gather fruit in Mango Mania. Guide it toward the mangoes scattered through the challenge and collect the food it needs. Work through the route while trying to bring every available fruit into the collection.

pages.title: Veggie Slicer
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Cut produce quickly in Veggie Slicer. Choose among three modes and slice the vegetables as they appear, keeping the action moving without missing targets. A missed vegetable costs a life, so accuracy matters alongside the speed of your cuts.

pages.title: 1Bird 1Color 1Target
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Save falling birds in 1Bird 1Color 1Target. Direct each creature toward a container of the same color and keep sorting as the waves accelerate. Gather as many birds as possible while managing the increasing pace of the descent.

pages.title: Backwater Fishing
pages.creator: Playcombo
pages.description: Choose tackle and try to land a catch in Backwater Fishing. Cast into the water, watch for activity, and reel in fish while comparing the available rods and bait. Different bait choices target different species, giving you a reason to adjust the setup between attempts.

pages.title: Money Movers 1
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Help two criminals escape in Money Movers 1. Coordinate their movements through the guarded prison, collect cash along the way, and avoid being caught by security. Both characters must reach the exit for their joint escape to succeed.

pages.title: Princess Back 2 School Lockers
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Customize school storage spaces in Princess Back 2 School Lockers. Help the senior students decorate their lockers for the final school year. Compare the available design choices and coordinate them into individual spaces that reflect each girl's preferences.

pages.title: Ice Skating Challenge
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare a mother and daughter for a competition in Ice Skating Challenge. Choose a skating costume for the princess, then create a separate outfit for her child. Coordinate both characters' looks so they are ready to take part in the contest.

pages.title: Princess Pool Party Floats
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Create seaside looks in Princess Pool Party Floats. Help the friends choose colorful outfits for a hot-weather gathering beside the pool. Explore the available fashion options and coordinate each character's appearance for their shared day in the sun.

pages.title: My Dolphin Show 7
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Help a trainer and dolphin entertain spectators in My Dolphin Show 7. Guide the aquatic performer through the show's tasks and work on completing the routine. The seventh adventure adds a Jungle World with eighteen stages for the pair to tackle.

pages.title: Poop Clicker 2
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Build an intentionally silly operation in Poop Clicker 2. Click the character to generate progress, then spend the proceeds on upgrades. Keep alternating between active clicking and improvements as you expand what the clicker can produce.
